page.content:
The Big Egg — January home of Wrestle Kingdom.

How Tokyo Dome connects

  • Event: Wrestle Kingdom — Wrestle Kingdom is staged at the Tokyo Dome.
  • Topic: NJPW — The Tokyo Dome is New Japan's January cathedral.

What is Tokyo Dome?

The Tokyo Dome is New Japan's cathedral: January 4 Dome Shows that became Wrestle Kingdom, where Inoki-era cards and the modern IWGP main events share the same roof.

Key threads lead to Wrestle Kingdom and NJPW.
